change: Split grids keep each collider's next link in its AABB's spare word (_pad1, previously an unread body id) instead of gColorLists, so a query fetches link and bounds with one 32-byte load per chain element. The legacy (scaled/fixed) grid keeps gColorLists.

gates.gpuLib: 50/50; the split lattice cases now read links from the AABBs and keep bijection, table placement and the brute-force pair oracle
